strategy: The robot will navigate toward the goal while avoiding obstacles by moving forward when clear and adjusting direction to avoid blocked paths.
decisions: If the path ahead is clear, then FORWARD
If an obstacle is detected on the LEFT, then RIGHT
If an obstacle is detected on the RIGHT, then LEFT
If the goal is reached, then STOP
If no path is available, then STOP
stop_point: When the goal is reached or when no path is available
